_source: config-proto/rzp/x/merchant/payouts/{workflows,fund_transfer,api_interface,cfa}.proto, config-proto/rzp/x/merchant/payouts/direct_accounts/{configs,payout_mode_config}.proto, cross-checked against findings/26_dcs_splitz_governor_shield.md:99-126,343-370. Key shape: {namespace:'rzp/x', entity:'merchant', entity_id, domain:'payouts'[/'direct_accounts'], object_name}. DCS wire protocol is protojson over goutils/dcs KV API (POST /v1/kv/get|put|patch) per findings/24_shared_libs_proto.md:305-337 -- this file gives the logical JSON value per key; the dcs-stub substitute may serve it directly as JSON (not validating real protobuf wire bytes), matching the convention already used by the ENV2_COMPOSE dcs-stub substitute.
_merchant_id_note: Arena merchant ids are ARENAM00000001 (M1), ARENAM00000002 (M2), ARENAM00000003 (M3) -- 14 chars exactly, matching payouts/fts merchant_id CHAR(14) columns. Deviates from the task prompt's illustrative 'ARENAM0000000001..3' (16 chars) which would silently truncate/collide in a CHAR(14) column.

ARENAM00000001._role: M1 -- Shared/Lite, ledger-backed balance, no workflow, no in-flight reservation (mirrors findings/26's merchant_test_001)

ARENAM00000002._role: M2 -- Direct/current account on RBL, x-balances-mirrored balance, in_flight_reservation_enabled ON (mirrors findings/26's merchant_test_002)

ARENAM00000003._role: M3 -- Shared, workflow-enabled with finance_l1/finance_l2/owner roles (mirrors findings/26's merchant_test_003)

_legacy_dcs_dual_write_note: The task also asks for 'legacy' flag names alongside DCS names. findings/26 (:203-240) found no literal second string name per flag -- the legacy interop is instead the Proxy service's DCSFeature{write_via_client, read_enabled_via_dcs, dual_write_enabled} (proto/dcs/proxy/v1/proxy.proto:40-49), which gates whether DCS or the legacy API-monolith MySQL 'Feature' table is authoritative for a given legacy flag name, per-flag. Since the arena's API monolith is itself a stub (monolith_fixtures.json), the 'legacy name' surface for payout_service_enabled and in_flight_reservation_enabled is represented there via the merchant.features list, kept in sync by hand with this file (see monolith_fixtures.json's _dcs_parity_note) rather than by a live dual-write mechanism.

dcs_feature_proxy_config._purpose: Optional: seed if the dcs-stub substitute also serves /v1/proxy/features/config/update reads. Not required for Env2 golden flows B (create->processed etc) since payouts reads DCS directly, not via Proxy.
